newsitem.title: USA: US Mid-Atlantic power drifts lower on cool weather.
newsitem.headline: US Mid-Atlantic power drifts lower on cool weather.

text.p: Spot electricity prices in the U.S. Mid-Atlantic drifted lower Friday on outlook of continued cool weather along the mid- to upper-portion of the eastern seaboard, market sources said.
"There're very few buyers...With the mild weather, there's not much going on," said a regional utility trader.

There were persistent discussions that utilities in the Pennsylvania-New Jersey-Maryland (PJM) Interconnect power pool would need to scale down output from baseload coal, even nuclear, power plants because of forecasts of a mininum generation or "min gen" situation this weekend.

A "min gen" scenario, which is typically this time of the year for PJM, occurs when minimum system demand falls below normal baseload generation. Utilities usually ramped down production from their plants to avoid overloading the regional electric grid.
In the PJM physical market, firm electricity prices for heavy load hours on Saturday was quoted at $16.00-$16.50 a megawatt hour (MWh); Sunday $15.00-$15.50; and Monday $20.00-$20.25.
On Thursday, firm, peak PJM power for Friday was assessed at $19.50-$20.75.
Firm PJM power for light-load hours for the weekend was quoted near $12.00, compared with off-peak prices at $13.00-$13.25 on Thursday.
PJM electricity for next week was last discussed at $19.50-$20.00, down from Thursday's $20.00-$20.50 range.
Peak, firm PJM electricity for October was quoted at $20.30-$20.50, compared with Thursday's $20.30-$20.40.
November PJM was pegged at $21.45-$21.65, compared with $21.50-$21.60 on Thursday. December PJM was assessed at $25.25-$22.50, wider than Thursday's $25.40-$25.50 range.
PJM delivery in the 1996 fourth-quarter was quoted at $22.25-$22.50, compared with $22.40-$22.60 on Thursday.
January/February 1997 PJM electricity was valued at $29.00-$29.30, off slightly from Thursday's $29.10-$29.40. First-quarter 1997 PJM delivery was discussed today at $27.30-$27.90.
